title: Vault-Mem eval set
description: A gold-set of Q&A pairs for testing memory retrieval quality on one project.

schema.description: Pinned schema id so future versions can be detected and migrated.

project.description: Project slug the eval set targets.

created.description: When the set was authored. Informational only — doesn't affect scoring.

description.description: Free-form note describing what this set covers.

id.description: Stable identifier for this question (used in reports, CI diffs).

question.description: Natural-language query that will be passed to memory.context.

expected_citations.description: Memory ids that should appear in the returned context bundle for this query to count as a hit.

top_k.description: How many returned items count toward precision. Default 10.

include_inbox.description: Whether to include inbox memories. Default false.

notes.description: Free-form note about what this question tests or why these citations were chosen.
